scope: R3-011 preservation of R3-007 authoritative postcondition source provenance
hypothesis: The hardened adapter validates postcondition_source before admitting authoritative evidence but then discards that source from the exported EvidenceRecord, leaving only a producer label and payload hash. Adding an immutable postcondition_source field can preserve auditability without changing factual admission decisions.
falsifiers: an authoritative R3-007 record exports no exact postcondition_source
two records from different postcondition sources cannot be distinguished without the unavailable original payload
a caller can create AUTHORITATIVE_STATE without a nonempty postcondition_source
proxy or OTHER evidence receives authoritative-source semantics
the patch changes valid match/mismatch decisions or reopens any of the three previously closed unsafe admissions

experiment.baseline: Create two valid authoritative R3-007 records with distinct filesystem postcondition sources and inspect record/export fields before patching.
experiment.trial: Add optional immutable postcondition_source to EvidenceRecord, require it for AUTHORITATIVE_STATE, populate it only from validated AUTHORITATIVE R3-007 evidence, and replay prior controls.
experiment.acceptance: Both exact sources survive record/export, direct source-less AUTHORITATIVE_STATE is refused, non-authoritative records carry null, valid decisions remain 2/2 and previous unsafe admissions remain 0.
experiment.candidate_boundary: isolated local branch; no push, merge, deploy or canonical adoption

limits: Preserving a source identifier does not prove that the named source is authoritative.
The source string may be public-safe metadata only; secrets and private payloads remain excluded.
Local deterministic evidence does not replace hosted or independent review.
